title: HumanStudy-Bench: Towards AI Agent Design for Participant Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Replicating classical human-subject experiments on cognitive biases (e.g., Anchoring Effect, Framing Effect, Representativeness Heuristic, False Consensus Effect) by instantiating LLMs as surrogate participants and comparing their behavioral effect sizes and statistical significance against human ground-truth data.

Simulating a social categorization experiment (minimal-group paradigm) to measure ingroup favoritism, evaluating whether LLM agents allocate more rewards to their assigned ingroup compared to an outgroup.
